[SWS_DM_01112] Event memory entry for events with the combina- tion on storage
⌈
If DiagnosticCommonProps.typeOfEventCombinationSup-
ported is set to eventCombinationOnStorage, then, the DM shall use the com-
bined UDS DTC status bit transitions as trigger source for the allocation of the
event memory entry, collection or update of the event related data.
⌋
